packages.author: JarlBrak
packages.changelog: Paladin 1.4.0 brings the class card into line with native class presentation and reduces starting equipment to Novice Hammer and Novice Aegis. Armor and the Tin Oath Token must be acquired during play; Smite becomes available when a Paladin trinket is equipped. Retains existing stats, combat mechanics, artwork and acquisition settings. Requires framework 1.2.1.
contentChanges: Uses a two-sentence flavor description, compact native-style class ability labels, and a Novice Hammer plus Novice Aegis starting kit.
Paladin class retains Guard and Cleansing March, which prevents new Poison and Curse while exploring.
All 14 Paladin hammers grant Censure, randomly lowering Armor or Resistance on successful debuff application.
All six Paladin trinkets grant Smite while equipped; trinkets must be acquired during play.
Smite deals modest magic damage and receives a sixfold bonus while its target has an active Censure Resistance reduction.
Replaces original equipment art across six families and three artifacts, with separate action symbols and native normal-Attack glyphs.
packages.description: Protect allies with Guard and Cleansing March, weaken enemies with Paladin hammers, and cast Smite through Paladin trinkets. Includes original equipment and action artwork.
packages.license: MIT (code); see ASSET-LICENSE.md for generated artwork
packages.name: Paladin
requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.2.1 or a compatible later 1.x release.
Published for Windows, macOS and Linux on the listed game build. Gameplay verified on macOS only; Windows and Linux gameplay remain unverified.
Complete skinset fit, native breakage, all display views and long-campaign balance are not yet comprehensively validated.
Generated artwork has separate terms; see the source and release asset ASSET-LICENSE.md.

packages.author: JarlBrak
packages.changelog: 1.0.0 playtest candidate. Ordinary Sneak Attack bonus tuned to 20%; Slip Away reports its spent state. Promotional banner is an illustration, not a gameplay screenshot.
contentChanges: Play a fast Thief with Speed-based two-handed paired daggers and bows.
Exploit openings and preparation with Sneak Attack; spend a turn on Slip Away.
Discover 45 equipment pieces across seven tiers, including Skeleton Key, Candle's End, and Unlost Road.
packages.description: A Speed-based paired-dagger specialist with tactical openings, bows, seven equipment tiers, and three artifact weapons. Version 1.0.0 playtest.
packages.name: Thief
requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.0.4 or later within 1.x.
Published for Windows, macOS and Linux on the listed game build. Gameplay verified on macOS only; Windows and Linux gameplay remain unverified.
Single-player playtest. Multiplayer, save/resume, and hot-reload lifecycle remain unverified.
Balance, higher-tier and female outfit fit, and final mouse usability remain under review.

packages.changelog: 1.0.0: Original cosmetic Possum race, faceted model and texture, smaller palms and fingers, and fourteen native class bindings.
contentChanges: Choose Possum alongside the native character appearances.
An original faceted possum model with a pointed muzzle, rounded ears and a long pink tail.
Keep your class abilities, stats and native equipment.
The tail follows the body; it has no independent animation.
packages.description: An original possum appearance for your adventurer, with faceted fur, rounded ears and a long pink tail. Keeps your class abilities, stats and native equipment.
